chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, Kha Siangtho a nei mite hilh bangin note kong hilh thei kei hi; leitung lungsim a nei mite, Khazih sungah nawi ne naungeekte ka hilh bangin kong hilh hi.
Note in an haizan zo nai lo na hih uh ciangin sa tawh kong vaak nai kei hi, nawizu bek kong tulh hi. Tu-in na haizan zo kei uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitung lungsim a nei mite na hi lai uh hi. Note lakah ki-en’na leh kitotna a om lai tengin leitung lungsim a nei mite hilo na hi uh hiam? Leitung mite’ ngeina bangin gamta hilo na hi uh hiam?
Mi khat in, “Paul’ mi ka hi,” ci a, khat in, “Apollos’ mi ka hi,” na cih uh ciangin leitung lungsim a nei mite hilo na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Apollos kua ahi hiam? Paul kua ahi hiam? Topa in thu a hong piak ciat mah bangin note thu up nadingin nasemte hilo ka hi uh hiam?
Keimah in a suanpa ka hi hi. Apollos in tuibuakpa ahi hi. A kung a khangsakpa ahih leh, Pasian ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a suanpa in mi phamawh ahi kei hi; tuibuakpa in mi phamawh ahi kei hi; a khangsakpa Pasian in mi phamawh ahi hi.
Ahih hangin a suanpa leh tui buakpa in mikhat ahi uh a, amau nasep bangin amau ciat in thaman a ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kote in Pasian tawh nasem khawm mi ka hi uh a, note in Pasian’ huan, Pasian’ inn na hi uh hi.

Pasian in thupha hehpihna hong piaksa ka ngah bangin inn lam siampa bangin inn khuam ka phut hi. Midangte in a ban zomin a lam uh hi. Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in tua khuam tungah zomin bangci-in a lam hiam ci-in kikem ta uh hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, khuam a kiphut zo Zeisu Khazih longal innkhuam dang kuamah in phut zo lo hi.
Tua khuam tungah kham, ngun, suangmanpha, sing, lopa, buhkungte a lam a om leh,

mi khempeuh ahihna hong kilang khia ding hi. Bang hong ci kilang ding ahi hiam na cih uh leh, tua Ni-in mei tawh kilangsak ding hi. Mikhempeuh’ nasepna in bang ci nasepna ahi hiam ci-in mei-in a kize-et ding hi.
Tua khuam tungah zomin a lam mi in a nasepna a kip leh, thaman a ngah ding hi.
Mikhat a nasepna a kattum leh, tuapa a zaang ding hi. Ahi zongin ama pumpi mei katna tawh a kipelh mah bangin gupna a ngah ding hi.
Note in Pasian’ biakna innpi na hi uh a, Pasian’ Kha Siangtho note sungah a ten’ lam thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Mikhat in Pasian’ biakna innpi a sukgawp leh, Pasian in tua pa a sugawp ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ biakna innpi a siangtho hi; note in tua biakna innpi na hi uh hi.
Kuamah peuhmah amah leh amah kikheem kei hen. Note lakah mi khatpeuh mah in hih leitung pilna ka nei hi ci-in a ki-up leh, tuapa in mi lungpil a suah nadingin mihai suak hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitungmi’ pilna in Pasian mai-ah haina ahi hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Lai Siangtho sungah, “Pasian in mi pilte amaute’ zuauthu tawh a man hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Khat vei, “Mi pilte’ hanciamna in a mawkna hi ci-in Pasian in a thei hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kuamah in mite hangin kisathei kei hen. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na khempeuh note ading ahi uh hi.

Paul ahi zongin, Apollos ahi zongin, Kefas ahi zongin, leitung ahi zongin, hin’na ahi zongin, sihna ahi zongin, tu-in a omte ahi zongin, tu nung ciangin hong piang dingte ahi zongin, tuate khempeuh note ading ahi uh hi.
Note in Khazih’ mi na hi uh a, Khazih in Pasian’ mi ahi hi.
